## Tab zoom

- Zoom shows one tab full-window, then restores the split layout with each tab back in its pane, at the sizes and selections it had.
- Toggle it with Ctrl+Shift+Z, the new tab-strip button, the View and tab menus, or the command palette.
- Tabs opened while zoomed join their neighbour's pane on restore, and saving a workspace while zoomed saves the split layout.
- Restored panes keep their share of the window as it resizes.

## Panes

- Panes animate when you split, collapse, zoom or unzoom. This follows the Windows animation effects setting.
- Terminals no longer flash black for a frame when panes resize or first appear.
- Alt+Shift+arrow moves the active tab into the neighbouring pane, the one Alt+arrow focuses.

## About

- Settings has an About section, also opened from View > About resesh or the command palette. It shows the version, Windows, .NET, Windows App SDK and libghostty-vt versions, links, the data and logs folders, the license and credits.
- Copy details puts the version and system info on the clipboard for bug reports.
- The app now reports its real version; before, it said 1.0.0.

## Faster SSH

- Saved SSH sessions open faster: about 15% sooner on a local server and 20% sooner over a 50 ms link, with one less round trip on a real network. Unreachable hosts still fail within seconds.

## Look and feel

- The tab-strip actions are quieter: the Files button is a plain toggle, icons are evenly sized and brighten on hover. "Go to terminal folder" moves into the file pane header.
- Placeholder text in fields and dialogs is dimmer, so it no longer reads as typed text.
- High Contrast no longer dims content behind overlays and draws the recording dot in the highlight color.

## Fixes

- Pasting text copied on Windows no longer enters each line twice.
- Shift+drag in apps that track the mouse, such as vim, tmux or Codex, starts a new selection instead of adding to the last one.
- A tab that finishes connecting no longer takes the keyboard from the command palette or session search while you type.
- Hovering a link that wraps over several rows underlines all of it.
- A session with shell integration turned on no longer makes the saved sessions file unreadable at launch, and tunnel and proxy settings keep their defaults when saved.
- Show commands no longer crashes when it opens.
- There is no longer a gap before the first tab, and dragging tabs stays within the tabs.
- Timed-out or cancelled connections no longer fill the crash log.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.
